value.name: reflects on neighborhood work
value.description: Asha steps onto the stoop and reflects that her work helped make the house and neighborhood possible, deciding that is enough.
evidence: Asha thought, this is a neighborhood, this is a block, this is a house on a block, and the people inside it are going to live here, and the work I did was a small piece of what made that possible, and that is enough. That is, in fact, more than enough. That is the work.

value.name: walks to two o'clock appointment
value.description: Asha leaves after her reflection and heads to her two o'clock appointment.
evidence: She walked to her two o'clock.

value.name: arrives on snowy Sunday evening
value.description: On the first Sunday in February, Asha goes to Lucia's house after the snow has stopped and the streets are wet and dark.
evidence: The Sunday after next was the first Sunday in February, and it snowed in the morning and then stopped, and by six the streets were wet and dark and the row houses on Spruce Street had their lamps on in their front rooms, and Asha walked up the steps and rang the bell and Lucia opened the door.
value.time_hint: the first Sunday in February, by six

value.name: notices Lucia wearing apron
value.description: Asha sees that Lucia is wearing an unfamiliar apron, which she does not mention.
evidence: She had not been wearing an apron any of the previous times Asha had seen her, and the apron, which had a faded pattern of small blue flowers, was clearly not Lucia's.

value.name: Lucia greets Asha with kiss
value.description: Lucia kisses Asha on the cheek and invites her inside as a witness to Rosa's complaint about the stew.
evidence: Lucia kissed her on the cheek, which she had also not done before, and said, "Come in, come in, Rosa is bullying me about the salt in the stew and I need a witness."

value.name: Asha declines witness role
value.description: Asha says she is no longer a witness but a guest, redefining her role in the household.
evidence: "I am not a witness anymore. I am a guest."

value.name: Lucia invites guest inside
value.description: Lucia accepts Asha's new status and invites her to come in as a guest and avoid taking sides.
evidence: "Then come in as a guest and refuse to take sides."

value.name: enters stew-scented house
value.description: Asha notices the house smells of stew, bread, and wood fire, signaling a warm domestic setting she had not anticipated.
evidence: The house smelled of stew and of bread and of a wood fire, which surprised her
